baseline_comparison.conclusion: The two cmd/tbound tests that fail at the snapshot head fail with the same names and messages at the pre-D09 parent f157bd9 (before both the D09 commit 89b76d0 and the settlement correction ebbbbbc). The failing predicate in the fixture is validWorkflowCatalogEntry (production_workflow_catalog_linux.go:1440, requires a bare AdmissionRecordHash), which the fixture does not satisfy because digestBytes returns a sha256:-prefixed value. That line is unchanged since f157bd9. These failures are pre-existing, not introduced by the D09 change, and were not fixed in this run.

limitations: Verified only the committed snapshot at the head above. Uncommitted work, including D14, is not validated.

The module-wide AGENTS.md gate is not green at this head: two cmd/tbound tests fail in both contexts. The same tests fail at the pre-D09 parent, so this is pre-existing and not a D09 regression. The D09 scope gates do not pass (d09_scope_status failed): TestD09CellTemplateDraftIsNotAdmissible is SKIPPED in both contexts, so skip_focus_no_new_privs_passes is false.
The snapshot has no .git directory. Tests that need the real repository metadata would fail here; none of the module results indicated such a dependency.

The no-new-privs context (setpriv --no-new-privs as uid 1000, NoNewPrivs=1, CapEff=0) does not un-skip TestD09CellTemplateDraftIsNotAdmissible. The xattr scanner profile also requires no unregistered supplementary groups, and uid 1000 holds 12. setgroups needs CAP_SETGID, so the test stays unverified in this environment. That is an environment limit, not a code failure. It was not worked around (no root, no account change).

uid 1000 is a member of the sudo, adm and docker groups. Group membership is not a capability and was not altered by this run. The registered xattr scanner profile does not register these groups, which is the skip reason 'xattr scanner has unregistered supplementary groups'.
The -v flag was added to go test for skip accounting. It does not change test selection.
Passing tests here verify code only. They are not G1, containment, H1, host ABI 8 or WSL ABI 1 evidence.
